categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Huaqi Environmental Protection & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: urban water environment comprehensive management, rural and township water environment governance, and medical wastewater treatment. The company provides integrated services including engineering design, equipment manufacturing, project construction, and operation and maintenance of sewage treatment facilities. It also engages in water treatment product sales and sewage treatment investment and operation through BOT, BOO, and TOT models.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology centers on the Biological Aerated Filter (BAF) process, an advanced sewage treatment technology recognized at the national level. It integrates biological treatment with intelligent control systems, including IoT, big data, and AI for smart water management. The company also develops intelligent sewage treatment equipment and modular, standardized products such as the 'Magic Cube' series for diverse water treatment scenarios. R&D focuses on automation, deep nitrogen and phosphorus removal, sludge drying, and resource recovery technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal governments, industrial enterprises, rural and township communities, and medical institutions requiring wastewater treatment solutions. Major markets cover urban sewage treatment plants, rural sewage collection and treatment, black and odorous water body remediation, and medical wastewater management. The company serves clients across multiple provinces in China and has begun expanding into international markets such as Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily concentrated in East China, including Anhui Province and neighboring regions. It has projects across major river basins and freshwater lakes in China. The company is also initiating global expansion through joint ventures and overseas subsidiaries, notably in Singapore and other Belt and Road Initiative countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Huaqi operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the water treatment supply chain. It provides engineering, equipment manufacturing, and operational services for sewage treatment facilities, including investment and operation under concession models. The company integrates technology development with project execution and facility management, positioning itself as a full lifecycle service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing smart water treatment technologies, including intelligent control systems and digital twin platforms. It emphasizes R&D in hydrogen energy and green low-carbon technologies, aiming to develop integrated water-hydrogen energy solutions. The company also prioritizes expanding its smart water management systems and enhancing its global market presence through innovation and strategic partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through three main channels: engineering contracting services (EPC), sales of water treatment products and equipment, and sewage treatment facility investment and operation fees under BOT, BOO, and TOT models. The company earns income from project construction, product sales, and ongoing operational fees for treated water services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the BAF technology field with national-level awards and patents, recognized as a specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It holds a competitive position in municipal and rural sewage treatment markets and medical wastewater treatment. Competitors include other environmental technology firms specializing in water treatment, but Huaqi’s integrated smart solutions and patented technologies provide differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 279 million, a 20.3% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 41.7 million. Total assets were about RMB 1.77 billion with net assets of RMB 804 million. The decline was mainly due to delayed order deliveries and increased depreciation from new projects. The company continues to invest in R&D and infrastructure, with a focus on long-term growth and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui Huaqi emphasizes its proprietary BAF core technology and intelligent water treatment equipment, offering high-efficiency, modular, and smart solutions tailored to diverse water treatment needs. Its integrated '4S' service model provides comprehensive lifecycle management from design to operation. The company’s smart water management platform enables centralized, visualized, and unmanned operation, particularly addressing challenges in rural and township sewage treatment. Its commitment to innovation and green low-carbon technologies further differentiates its offerings.
